description: Updates the report_status of a specific accession test line item, typically after report generation.
validation: accessionTestId must exist and belong to organization + branch + accessionId
reportStatus must be one of PENDING, READY, RELEASED (CHECK)

errors.condition: reportStatus missing or not a recognized enum value
accessionTestId not found / not in organization+branch scope

notes: docs/API_Contracts_and_Test_Results.xlsx documents the sample response value as GENERATED, but the actual CHECK constraint on accession_tests.report_status (database/schema/018_accession_tests.sql) only allows PENDING, READY, RELEASED - GENERATED is not a valid value at the database level. The success example here uses READY (matching API-T109's tested value) instead.
